blocks.text: You can connect your Databricks organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Account Admin privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your Databricks organization.
To connect your Databricks organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Databricks.
(Optional) In the Add Integration window, enter the Tenant name.
Enter your Databricks Account ID. To learn how to locate your account ID, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Create an account-level service principal. To learn more, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Assign the Account Admin role to the service principal. To learn more, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Enter the Client ID and Client secret. To learn how to generate the client ID and client secret, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Click Connect to complete the integration.

blocks.text: Your Databricks organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
